review.gallery: The lead elevation is the official project page render, framed to show the crown and podium in the gallery and listing card. Eight additional project-specific renders come from the official brochure.
review.location: Physical page 11 marks the project and gives journey estimates. The table and narrative differ for Downtown and the airport. The page uses the table with the discrepancy noted.
review.floorPlans: Fourteen residential types and totals visually checked on official pages 18, 20, 21 and 23 and Housebook pages 2–5. The smaller plan document reproduces the same drawings and disclaimers with different raster compression. The three floor overviews were checked on the separately attributed launch PDF. Historical commercial pages were not used to infer current offers or measurements.
